name: Larry Page
tier_justification: Father Carl Page was CS professor at MSU; mother Gloria taught programming at Lyman Briggs College — professional academic household, not inherited wealth.

name: Sergey Brin
tier_justification: Parents Michael and Eugenia Brin were Soviet émigré academics (mathematics/economics); professional class, not tier-4 wealth.

name: Elon Musk
tier_justification: Father Errol Musk was electromechanical engineer; mother Maye was model — upper-middle/professional, not old-money tier 4.

name: Mark Zuckerberg
tier_justification: Parents Edward (dentist) and Karen (psychiatrist); attended Phillips Exeter Academy — elite prep and professional parents.

name: Bill Gates
tier_justification: Father William H. Gates Sr. was prominent Seattle attorney; mother Mary Gates served on corporate boards — connected professional elite.

name: Jensen Huang
tier_justification: Taiwan-born; raised by aunt/uncle in Oregon after father (airport dispatcher) sent him abroad; middle-class immigrant household.

name: Larry Ellison
tier_justification: Adopted by aunt/uncle in Chicago; father was government accountant — middle class, not elite.

name: Jeff Bezos
tier_justification: Biological father absent; stepfather Miguel Bezos was Cuban immigrant engineer; mother Jackie was teen mother who completed college later.

name: Steve Ballmer
tier_justification: Father Fred Ballmer was Ford manager; mother Beatrice was accountant — professional middle/upper-middle.

name: Michael Dell
tier_justification: Father was orthodontist; mother was stockbroker — affluent professional Austin household.

name: Dustin Moskovitz
tier_justification: Attended Vanguard High School (magnet); Harvard roommate of Zuckerberg — similar elite pipeline; parents less documented.

name: Reed Hastings
tier_justification: Both parents were attorneys in DC; attended private schools before Bowdoin — professional class.

name: Jack Dorsey
tier_justification: Raised in St. Louis; father Tim was mass spectrometry engineer — middle-class technical household.

name: Patrick Collison
tier_justification: Irish; parents Lorraine (microbiology) and Denis (engineering) — professional; moved to US for Patrick's MIT.

name: John Collison
tier_justification: Same household as Patrick Collison — professional Irish family.

name: Jan Koum
tier_justification: Ukrainian immigrant; mother worked as babysitter; father absent; welfare and food stamps in Mountain View — tier 1.

name: Travis Kalanick
tier_justification: Father Donald was civil engineer for nuclear power plants — middle-class technical.

name: Peter Thiel
tier_justification: German immigrant parents; father Klaus was chemical engineer — professional, not finance elite.

name: Reid Hoffman
tier_justification: Father William was real estate lawyer in Berkeley — professional class Bay Area.

name: Marc Benioff
tier_justification: Great-grandfather was Time Inc. chairman; father Russell was executive at Federated Department Stores — connected wealth.
